metadata.title: Uneven source normalization and the boundary 0.874828524351
metadata.description: Proves the all-moduli Dirichlet nonvanishing boundary 874828524351/1000000000000, with the principal pole excluded. Refines Gao PR63 using saturated marked capacities, retained sixth-root weights, a short-width moment bootstrap, and clipped uneven normalization with common-factor cost 2/5. The proof first improves the incumbent 0.87483 to 0.8748286 and then proves the stated exact boundary. Sil, with OpenAI Codex assistance. Builds on Zhongpai Gao, OpenAI, Hailey Collet, Akash Levy, timbalud and DaysSky; inherited source notices are retained. Official admission is determined by the repository checks.

pr.title: Prove the Dirichlet boundary 0.874828524351
pr.body:
QRH-Result: sil-uneven-normalization-20261019
QRH-Bound: 874828524351/1000000000000
QRH-Decimal: 0.874828524351

Proves that every Dirichlet L-function is nonzero for Re(s) > 0.874828524351,
with the principal pole excluded. The proof refines PR63 using uneven source
normalization, retained sixth-root weights, saturated marked capacities, and
a short-width moment bootstrap. Its two-stage argument first proves
0.8748286 from PR63's 0.87483, then proves the stated rational boundary.

Candidate.bound and its required supporting modules passed serial local
checks in the pinned Lean 4.34.1 project, using only propext, Classical.choice,
and Quot.sound. Repository admission, Comparator, and independent-kernel
verification are separate checks; no official admission is claimed here.

Only metadata.json and the reachable Lean source closure are included in the
submission folder. The original PR63 proof is reused, with inherited source
and attribution notices retained. No existing submission is modified.

Sil, with OpenAI Codex assistance. Attribution to Zhongpai Gao, OpenAI,
Hailey Collet, Akash Levy, timbalud and DaysSky is retained in the metadata
and source notices.
